title: cerastium subtriflorum
intro: Cerastium subtriflorum, commonly known as Small-flowered Mouse-ear Chickweed, is a flowering plant species in the carnation family that is native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium subtriflorum include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
